result.reason: Paragraph 7(d) reaches the preferred vendor-indemnity position: it covers third-party IP claims, legal violations, vendor-caused data incidents, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, protects Company and its affiliates, and includes notice, cooperation, defence control, and settlement protections. The absence of a Company indemnity is no broader than the playbook limitation. However, new paragraph 7(c) adds an unrelated bilateral attorneys’ fees waiver, which is not necessary to implement the indemnity and materially changes unrelated rights. The heading also remains misleadingly titled “Indemnification of Contractor” although the operative indemnity runs in favor of Company.
